shots.setup: G.filmCam = null; if (window.__d && G.ember.champions().endDuel) { G.ember.champions().endDuel(); window.__d = null; } G.champ = null; for (const k in (G.bosses||{})) { const b = G.bosses[k]; if (b.active && b.stop) b.stop(); } G.enemies.clearAll && G.enemies.clearAll(); for (const q of (G.enemies.encounters || [])) q.cleared = true; { const SP = G.combat.powers && G.combat.powers.spout; if (SP && SP.clear) SP.clear(); } { const h0 = G.hero; h0.carried = null; if (h0.endFly) h0.endFly(); h0.fly = false; h0.glide = false; h0.fireAir = false; } if (window.__keep) { G.combat.data.champions.phases.forEach((p, i) => (p.moves = window.__keep[i])); window.__keep = null; } window.__want = null; window.__to = null; window.__orb = null; window.__e = null; window.__B = null; window.__b = null; window.__wn = 0; window.__burnt = false; G.ember.setSide('water', { place: false, quiet: true }); Q.start(); G.bot = null; G.quest.botDrive = null; G.quest.debugRingAll(); const h = G.hero, V = h.pos.constructor; h.hp = h.maxHp = 900; h.tide = h.maxTide = 100; for (const k in h.powers) h.powers[k] = true; h.inv = 1e6; window.__n = 0; if (G.sky.setHour) G.sky.setHour(0.5); const a = G.world.data.arena; h.pos.set(a.x, a.z + 8, -a.y + 10); h.prev.copy(h.pos); window.__pp = {6:'atk', 16:'atk', 26:'atk', 44:'wave', 70:'atk', 80:'atk', 96:'spin'}; __rig.ots(() => G.boss && G.boss.head, { back: 4.0, side: -1.5, up: 0.6, w: 0.45, fov: 60 }); 'ok'
shots.each: window.__n++; const n = window.__n, h = G.hero, B = G.boss; h.inv = 1e6; h.hp = h.maxHp; h.tide = h.maxTide; if (B && B.hp < B.maxHp * 0.35) B.hp = B.maxHp * 0.8; const w = { mx: 0, my: 0, ud: 0 }; if (B && B.head) { const dx = B.head.x - h.pos.x, dz = B.head.z - h.pos.z, dy = B.head.y - h.pos.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dz); G.camYaw = Math.atan2(dx, dz); G.camPitch = Math.max(-0.5, Math.min(0.5, Math.atan2(dy, d))); w.my = d > 13 ? 0.7 : 0; } const PP = window.__pp || {}; if (PP[n % 120]) w[PP[n % 120]] = true; Q.drive(w);
shots.log: (() => { const c = G.camera, h = G.hero, p = (h.drawPos || h.pos).clone(); p.y += 0.9; const d = +p.distanceTo(c.position).toFixed(1); p.project(c); const B = G.boss; let b = null; if (B && B.head) { const q = p.clone().set(B.head.x, B.head.y, B.head.z); const bd = +q.distanceTo(c.position).toFixed(1); q.project(c); b = [+q.x.toFixed(2), +q.y.toFixed(2), bd]; } return [+p.x.toFixed(2), +p.y.toFixed(2), d, b]; })()
